scenes.text: Imagine driving into a scorching desert, seeing absolutely nothing but dirt, and realizing an entire town of thousands of people is living right beneath your feet.
Here, the summer heat is so brutal it regularly hits one hundred and twenty degrees, making life on the surface nearly impossible.
You will find beautiful underground homes carved into the sandstone, complete with modern kitchens, indoor swimming pools, cozy bars, and even fully functioning churches.
Would you survive living in a luxury cave like this, or would you go crazy?
